title: Gesture Recall · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Gesture Recall · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner prepares three small, safe gestures. The partner shows the gestures once; the lead repeats them in order. All three gestures are repeated correctly. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Gesture Recall, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All three gestures are repeated correctly.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: All three gestures are repeated correctly.
